messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan - owner / dates confirmation

Hi Alex & Samantha,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the deep dive into the Acme search/FAQ and the 200k monthly queries you mentioned. I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan that captures the evaluation milestones we discussed: kickoff, data onboarding, pilot, and pilot evaluation.

Action items I put in the MAP (attached):
- Confirm the internal owners for each milestone (who will own data ingestion, integration testing, and pilot success metrics)
- Confirm target dates for kickoff, data delivery, and pilot start
- Identify any gating items (security/compliance signoffs, firewall/VPC access)

Can you do two quick things this week?
1) Reply with the owner names (or updated roles) and any date changes directly in the MAP (I highlighted the cells).
2) If you'd prefer, book a 30-min sync and I can walk through the plan with the owners — link here: https://calendar.redwood.com/marissa/30min

Attachment: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel)

If priorities/timing have shifted since the call, no problem — just let me know and I’ll update the plan.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference for production
